The word Esophagogastroduodenoscopy looks like a nightmare to figure out, but for anyone who knows basic medical terminology it's an easy term. Scopy is to examine and the rest of the word is just the path of the examining scope. Through the esophagus, stomach, and then the duodenum. Can Scar Tissue Be Turned Back Into Beating Heart Cells After a Heart Attack?

It will probably be a decade before this translates into treatments for the average citizen, but it will make a huge difference for long-term survival rates after heart attacks. Currently once cardiac tissue dies, it can no longer transmit the electrical impulses to constrict the tissue. Once too much tissue in an important area dies, you see major side effects and more heart attacks eventually lead to death. Being able to rebuild dead tissue will change our entire treatment and outlook for cardiac patients.
